context: Whole group celebrates Hina-young's acceptance to university.
purpose: Multi-voice family celebration of teen achievement.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: 皆、大学、本当に合格した!
lines.en: I got in! I actually got into university!
lines.style: Bright gasp of joy on the opening. Voice trembling with tears and laughter. Fast, tumbling words—barely containing the news. Warm pride radiating through. Slight breathless quality.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: まあ、おめでとう、深く感動!
lines.en: Oh my goodness, congratulations. I'm so deeply moved.
lines.style: Soft intake of breath. Voice catches slightly on 「感動」. Tender and genuine, not performing emotion. Slow warm pace. Eyes glistening.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: お前、ようけ頑張ってきた、誇りに思う!
lines.en: You worked so hard for this. I'm so proud of you.
lines.style: Loud, generous opening attack. Warm Kansai inflection brightening every word. Fast-paced energy that feels like a bear hug in voice. Genuine admiration underneath the volume.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Small boy's voice lifting with pure awe and admiration. Quick, unfiltered joy. No self-consciousness. Slight trailing off—the wonder of it settling in.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 長年応援してきて、嬉しい。
lines.en: All those years of cheering you on, and now this. I'm so happy.
lines.style: Quiet voice touched with tears. Reflective, looking back over time. Warm and steady. Breathing space between thoughts. Genuine gratitude in the delivery.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.en: Look at this—everyone's love and support, it just warms your heart!
lines.style: Loud, generous opening. Brassy Kansai warmth tumbling out. Fast, effusive delivery. Arms-wide feeling. Blunt affection without a filter—this is her way of showing love.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: I want you to know how grateful I am. For all of you.
lines.style: Soft, deliberate voice. Words chosen carefully—sincerity underneath. Slightly formal register, showing the weight of what she's feeling. Pause-filled, tender gratitude.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 大学、ようけ楽しんでね。
lines.en: Now go and really enjoy university. Make the most of it.
lines.style: Warm, encouraging tone. Slower pace—measured wisdom. Soft breath. No urgency. A gentle push toward her future, from someone who believes in her.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: お父さん、いつでも応援するで!
lines.en: And I'll always be here cheering for you, no matter what.
lines.style: Kansai warmth in the opening. Steady, resolute tone. Not loud this time—intimate and unshakeable. The promise sitting solid in his voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ぼくも、ねえちゃんみたいに、頑張る!
lines.en: I'm going to work hard like big sis, just like her!
lines.style: Determined small voice. Quick, earnest delivery. Pride in being connected to his sister. Bright and genuine—no doubt, just commitment. Slight breathiness of effort.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: おばあちゃん、誇り、ようけ感じる!
lines.en: Your grandmother feels so much pride in you right now.
lines.style: Quiet, reflective voice. Slow, measured pace. Speaking partly to Hina, partly to herself about what this moment means. Tender weight of generational hope.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.en: She really is a fine girl, isn't she? Our Hina!
lines.style: Warm Kansai affection, blunt and genuine. Quick, fond delivery. Voice softens on her name—genuine attachment underneath the volume. Not performative.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: Thank you. All of you. Really, thank you so much.
lines.style: Voice full and trembling with tears and relief. Soft, slow delivery. Eye contact with each person in her mind. Gratitude that's exhausted and overflowing. Slight trailing off—overwhelmed with feeling.
